resources.string: Eatova reads your steps from Health Connect to display daily activity and estimate calories burned. Daily totals are stored in your encrypted app cache and are not uploaded to Eatova\'s servers. If you use the AI Coach after agreeing to AI processing, the calories-burned estimate derived from your steps is sent with your question. Eatova also reads your weight from Health Connect: once you allow the scale import in the app, new weigh-ins from your scale or other apps are added to your weight history, which syncs with your Eatova account like a weigh-in you enter yourself. Eatova does not write to Health Connect. You can revoke steps or weight access at any time in Health Connect settings.
